trigger.what: The platform opened Home & Kitchen to new sellers in our region, with the category fee schedule published.
Prospector scored audience overlap against our buyer base and flagged the under-35 gap as the largest unaddressed segment.
Navigator opened a business case and pinned the card. Onboarding incentives expire Sep 26, which is what makes this a dated decision.

constraints.label: MAP posture
constraints.detail: No price below MAP on any channel, whatever the platform’s promotional calendar pushes. Platform-funded discounts are acceptable; ours are not.

constraints.label: Content control
constraints.detail: Brand-owned creative is approved before it runs. Creator content carries no product claim we have not signed off, and no claim about competitors at all.

constraints.label: Integration capacity
constraints.detail: One engineer-month available in Q4. The channel runs on the existing connector and the existing catalogue mapping, or it waits.

constraints.label: Written rationale either way
constraints.detail: Go, pilot or no-go, the reasoning is filed as a Ledger asset with the numbers it was based on, so the next person to ask can read the answer.

agents.name: Prospector
agents.role: Audience overlap, competitive density and CAC estimates.

agents.name: Navigator
agents.role: Owns the business case and the 90-day gate.

agents.name: Merchandiser
agents.role: Assortment, listing content and per-unit economics.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Inventory positioning and the units committed to the pilot.

agents.name: Channel Fit Score
agents.role: Five-axis fit model, calibrated on our four live channels.

agents.name: Business Case Model
agents.role: P&L ramp with P10 / P50 / P90 and launch costs.
